title: Role of Entrepreneurship in Economic Development
learning_outcome: Discuss the economic contribution of entrepreneurship.

alignment.course_outcome: CO1 - Discuss the fundamentals of entrepreneurship

template_credit: 6-Tabs interaction template by Montse Anderson, elearningdesigner.com

illustration.subject: A new engineering venture creating outward economic ripples through jobs, suppliers, productivity, regional activity, exports and inclusive community benefits
illustration.composition: Concentric ripple landscape expanding from a workshop into city, region and global connections
illustration.style: Optimistic panoramic editorial illustration with layered economic systems and human outcomes

case: Case connection: India's diverse startup ecosystem provides a qualitative lens for employment, regional diffusion, women-led ventures, innovation and supplier effects.
misconception: Common mistake: Counting every new firm as economic development without examining productivity, survival, job quality, ethics or environmental responsibility.
application: Trace one engineering venture's direct, supplier, customer and regional effects, including one possible negative externality.
